d:
Dharti aaba bhagvan birsa munda ki 151vin jayanti ko bhavy rup se manane ki taiyari men bhajpa juti huee hai. is mauke par bhajpa ki or se jharkhand sahit deshbhar men janjatiy gaurav divas manaya jaega. pradesh bhajpa ne rashtriy netritv ke nirdesh par 11 se 18 navanbar tak desh ke har janjati bahul jile, vidhanasbha aur sabhi mandal men janjati gaurav divas manaya jaega.
